Apply: In the database: sec.usp_SeedCoreRoles (db/static/057_core_roles.sql), run by the onboarding job JOB-PLT-ONBOARD before sec.usp_InviteFirstAdministrator. Insert only: a run adds what is missing the first time; a later run of the same version adds nothing and reports what the tenant changed.
